q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of a modular kitchen cabinet?
title: Modular kitchen cabinet carbon footprint
short: Measure the board area per cabinet, multiply by the board supplier's figure, and add laminate, edge band, hinges and channels. Add panel cutting, edge banding and drilling energy, then divide the plant's energy by cabinets made.

ul: Particle board, MDF or plywood carcass.
Decorative laminate or acrylic and edge band.

p: Report per cabinet by size, or per running metre for a full kitchen. Board is usually most of the footprint.

example.title: Worked example: plant energy per cabinet (one month)
lines: Plant total: 21,300 / 3,000 = 7.100 kg CO2 per cabinet
Add board, laminate and hardware for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your own bills and production records.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
